item.title: Ama no Sora Retrospect
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GLace
  • 発売日: 2015-10-30
  • スコア: 7.2700000000000005/10 (58 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 天ノ空レトロスペクト
  • 英語名: Ama no Sora Retrospect

别名

  • Amatoro

あらすじ

Amanosora is a small town of around 60,000 people, formed ten years ago from the merger of the villages of Tensei and Sorami. Shikimi attends the local school with the cleaning club leader Himari and his lively kouhai Shinon. There’s a rumour at the school that the door to another world would be opened by pressing a certain sequence of buttons in the elevator at the lighthouse in the Stargazing Commemorative Hall.

item.description:

  • ブランド: GLace
  • 発売日: 2015-05-29
  • スコア: 6.709999999999999/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋魂
  • 英語名: Koitama

别名

  • 恋魂 －こいたま－

あらすじ

“Be pure, honest, strong-willed and wise!”

Those are the ideals that Aika forced upon the students at the special correctional institute Shindou Gakuen, forbidding love and depriving their freedom in the name of justice. While the ideal sounds great, in reality, the students are completely enslaved by the superhuman-like elite group, “Love Pentagon”.

item.title: Koishiki Manual
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GLace
  • 発売日: 2014-02-28
  • スコア: 7.340000000000001/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋式マニュアル
  • 英語名: Koishiki Manual

あらすじ

Ichinose Academy is a famous private school which is the best at everything, except its students have no romantic appeal. One fine autumn morning, the principal’s daughter Himeno declared that they will have a test to determine each student’s riajuu level. For someone who has never had a girlfriend, Hiroki naturally flunked the test. He was moved, along with five others girls who failed, to a special love training class called the “love manual”. Let the lessons of love begin!
